policy.hierarchical_action: Bernoulli irrigation gate plus active-only tanh-Gaussian amount_fraction
policy.fairness_rule: For the same seed, actor and reward critic architecture and initial parameters exactly match PPO v1. Extra capacity remains limited to the risk critic and three scalar dual multipliers; v2 zero-initializes only the extra risk-critic value head.

objective.primary: maximize expected water return, equivalently minimize expected controllable postplant irrigation

risk_constraint.grouping: Each eta is estimated independently from exactly 18 equally weighted training weather-year episodes per update.
risk_constraint.tau_estimator: For each eta and update, tau is the empirical lower-alpha quantile: the ceil(alpha*n)-th smallest retention. With n=18 and alpha=0.20 this is the fourth-smallest retention.
risk_constraint.actor_risk_constant_omitted: The eta-tau term is constant with respect to the action distribution when tau is frozen at the batch optimum; by the envelope argument it is omitted from the actor/risk-critic return to avoid score-function variance.
risk_constraint.exact_contract_check: The Rockafellar-Uryasev value at empirical tau must numerically equal the exact fractional order-statistic estimator from awm-risk-contract-v1.

lagrangian.primal_order: Freeze lambda_k, tau_k and all tail assignments for the complete PPO update; update actor/reward critic/risk critic; then update duals to lambda_{k+1}.

optimizer.name: Adam
optimizer.advantage_normalization: standardize reward and tail-risk components before dual weighting; do not standardize the combined advantage after applying lambda
optimizer.risk_advantage_conditioning: standardize A_tail_risk independently within each eta group so collapsed low-retention batches retain directional tail contrast
optimizer.gradient_clipping: clip actor, reward critic, and risk critic parameter groups independently at max_grad_norm=0.5 before the shared Adam step
optimizer.v2_rationale: Preserve exact lower-CVaR/RU semantics while preventing tiny tail-hinge scale, post-combination normalization, random initial risk baseline, and critic spikes from suppressing primal risk response.

tail_credit.risk_critic_target: Monte-Carlo complete-episode risk return h_i on every transition (gamma=1), unchanged from RCWA v2.
tail_credit.risk_critic_prefit: Before actor PPO optimization on every completed rollout, fit ONLY the risk critic to the frozen MC risk returns using the same on-policy batch.
tail_credit.prefit_epochs_rationale: Deliberately matched to optimizer.update_epochs so the prefit budget is not an independently tuned scientific hyperparameter.
tail_credit.risk_credit_prefit_learning_rate: optimizer.learning_rate (1e-4), using the existing shared Adam optimizer; no second optimizer is created and actor/reward-critic optimizer semantics are unchanged.
tail_credit.risk_credit_prefit_gradient_clipping: clip only risk-critic gradients at max_grad_norm=0.5
tail_credit.actor_credit: delta_t^risk = c_t + gamma_risk * V_r(s_{t+1}) * (1 - d_t) - V_r(s_t), computed under no_grad from the frozen post-prefit risk critic
tail_credit.actor_credit_frozen: The credit tensor is detached once per update and is never recomputed during the PPO minibatch epochs, including while the risk critic keeps training on its Monte-Carlo value loss.
tail_credit.actor_credit_combination: A_actor = z_global(A_reward) - lambda_eta * z_within_eta(delta_risk); identical v2 conditioning applied to the TD credit.
tail_credit.actor_tail_risk_symbol: In v3 the symbol A_tail_risk used by optimizer.combined_actor_advantage denotes the frozen one-step tail TD credit defined in this section; the conditioning and combination rule are unchanged from v2.
tail_credit.telescoping_invariant: For gamma_risk=1 and every complete episode with terminal next value zero: sum_t delta_t^risk = h_i - V_r(s_0), checked at runtime.
tail_credit.telescoping_enforcement: verified on every update; a violation raises instead of being silently disabled
tail_credit.no_schedule_prior: No conventional schedule, stage threshold, hand-written DAP pacing penalty, reward shaping, distributional return critic, dynamic CVaR or extra expected-shortfall objective is introduced. The mechanism only redistributes the same terminal tail information across time using a learned Markov risk value.

rollout.risk_assignment_time: after all 54 episodes are collected and before PPO optimization

interaction_budget.fairness_rule: Exactly the same maximum training interaction budget as PPO v1 and PPO-Lagrangian v1; risk estimation and dual updates use only the existing 54 rollout episodes.

change_rule: RCWA v3 is a new protocol derived from v2 forensic findings. The only scientific mechanism change is the actor's tail-risk temporal credit: a risk-critic prefit plus a frozen one-step tail TD credit replacing the Monte-Carlo risk advantage. All risk semantics, dual hyperparameters, architecture, interaction budget, seeds, checkpoint cadence and evaluation action mode are unchanged. Any further change to those, or to the tail-credit mechanism, requires a new protocol version.
